key_decisions.rationale: runtime_manager decides next-cycle policy; runtime_control_packet should serialize that policy into ordered commands a future native runtime can consume.
The project is not yet a game hook, driver hook, or OS scheduler; every new layer must preserve that safety boundary.

handoffs.summary: Confirmed runtime_control_packet is aligned after runtime_manager and recommended using setting instead of per-command mode.
Specified the v0.34 contract, integration sequence, pressure/stable test expectations, and QA gates.
Approved v0.34 with non-blocking recommendations: cover reserve/observe memory branches, align reserve command naming, and assert packet ordering.
Confirmed fixes for memory branch coverage, reserve_memory_headroom naming, and command order assertions.
Final re-review approved v0.34 delivery with no blockers after 96 tests, diff check, version check, and JSON validation.
